summary: Keeping argument_spec as a module-level variable allows explicit argument tests and easy creation of module objects; the same restructuring helps test other parts like the query logic.
questions: Why keep argument_spec at module level?
Can I restructure other parts of a module for testing too?

answer_card.title: Expose argument_spec for tests
answer_card.answer_md: A module-level `argument_spec` lets tests check the arguments directly and build module objects easily. Splitting other parts the same way, such as the code that queries the object being configured, makes them testable too.
